blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.payment` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of payments. It sends a request to the 
[List Payments](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payments\_getpayments) API route.

blocks.html:
This method captures a payment. It sends a request to the
[Capture Payment](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payments\_postpaymentsidcapture) API route.

The API route uses the `capturePayment` method of the payment provider associated with the payment's collection.

children.name: amount
children.description:
Custom amount to capture. If not specified, the
payment's amount is captured.

blocks.html:
This method refunds a payment. It sends a request to the
[Refund Payment](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payments\_postpaymentsidrefund) API route.

The API route uses the `refundPayment` method of the payment provider associated with the payment's collection.

children.name: amount
children.description:
Custom amount to refund. If not specified, the
payment's amount is refunded.

children.name: refund_reason_id
children.description: The ID of the refund's reason.

children.name: note
children.description: A note to attach to the refund.
